tasks.completion_summary: Fixed cursor row drift at scroll region boundary by tracking scrollTop/scrollBottom and preventing cursorRow increment when at scrollBottom during linefeed, IND, NEL, and character wrap

Verified process tree cleanup implementation is complete in go-cli-server v0.3.2: signalProcessGroup walks descendants via /proc or pgrep, DescendantTracker with background scanner persists descendant PIDs, waitForProcess kills stragglers post-exit, orphan cleanup includes stored descendants. All tests pass including tree cleanup tests for deep hierarchies and setsid grandchildren.
Improved BuildSystemPrompt to include get_errors and responsive_audit in tool list, added debugging workflow with 6-step sequence, common patterns section, and process management guidance

Fixed duplicate daemon processes on Windows by adding cleanupStale(), isOurDaemonProcess(), and terminateProcess() to go-cli-server socket_windows.go. Listen() now probes the socket before removing it instead of blindly deleting. checkExisting() now terminates zombie daemons with unresponsive sockets.
